about_the_game:
What if someone you lost suddenly came back — as if nothing ever happened?

In this short, hand-drawn visual novel with point-and-click elements, you follow a girl revisiting a quiet street from her past — the one where she once lived with her partner, who mysteriously disappeared years ago.

She had no answers, only silence. Time passed, and all she could do was move on. But today, as she walks those familiar sidewalks again, he suddenly appears — unchanged, as if nothing had happened.

Together, they talk. About the past. About what came after. About everything left unsaid.

You will guide their conversation, make choices that reflect how she remembers, feels, and decides to face the truth — or avoid it. The story branches into several endings depending on how you respond.

Is this reunion a second chance? Or a final goodbye?

Features

  • Branching dialogue with meaningful choices

  • Hidden objects and story clues to discover

  • Multiple endings shaped by your decisions

  • Hand-drawn art, original soundtrack, and deep narrative

  • Developed solo with care and attention to detail

  • Available in English, Russian, and Japanese
